items.title: DRDO & IAF successfully conduct maiden flight-trial of Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation weapon
items.snippet: Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau Ministry of Defence DRDO & IAF successfully conduct maiden flight-trial of Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation weapon Posted On: 08 MAY 2026 10:07AM by PIB Delhi Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) and the Indian Air Force (IAF) successfully conducted the maiden flight-trial of Tactical Advanced Range Augmentation (TARA) weapon off the coast of Odisha on…
